author: blu
body: Depth is capped, and a bridge is followed only when its secondary bus is GREATER than the bus the bridge was found on. Both bounds are about a malformed or hostile bridge rather than a real one: a bridge that reports its own bus, or a lower one, would otherwise make the walk cycle forever.

author: blu
body: This used to be pci-enable-mmio and set memory space alone. It also had no callers anywhere in the tree, so nothing had yet been mis-enabled by it; the name is retired rather than kept beside a correct one, because two functions here would only invite the wrong one. arm64-pci-enable-device has set all three since it was written and VirtioPci calls it -- this is that function, on the CAM side of the same question.
